thread:
Maya Patel: Hi @people-ops — I'm requesting an accommodation under ADA. I have ADHD and sensory processing challenges. Open plan + back-to-back meetings are causing frequent shutdowns and my recent performance metrics slipped. I'd like to request: a quiet desk or private room 2 afternoons/week, noise-cancelling headphones, and ability to have fewer synchronous meetings (or async alternatives). I'm willing to upload documentation to HR. Thank you.

Jordan Lee: Thanks for flagging this, Maya. We'll handle confidentially. Can you DM me your preferred 2 afternoons? We'll set up an intake with @Aisha Khan (HRBP) and loop in accommodations team. You can upload any docs to the secure portal or email accommodations@redwood.com. :white_check_mark:

Sam Torres: Maya — I can reduce your meetings and provide written summaries. Which meetings are the worst for you? I can cover if needed.

Maya Patel: The daily 10am standup is ok if it's 5m or async. The Tue/Thu 3pm design reviews are hard — long, loud. Private room in afternoons would help for deep work. Headphones would help for incidental noise.

Priya Singh: We can provision a quiet desk or reserve a small room for 90 days as an interim step and approve noise-cancelling headphones up to $150. I'll send the intake link. We'll need a completed accommodations form to formalize — link: https://internal.redwood/hr/accommodations (internal only). I'll schedule an intake 1:1 w/ @Aisha and @Maya for Wed 2pm. Interim actions: Sam to reduce meeting load for 4 weeks, provide written agendas, and do weekly 30-min check-ins.

Aisha Khan: Sending invite for Wed 2pm now. We'll treat this as supportive accommodations — not a PIP. We'll document agreed interim adjustments in HR (confidential). We'll also add checkpoints to manager guidance so expectations are clear. :hugging_face:

Sam Torres: Invite accepted. I'll update the team's calendar and set weekly 30-min check-ins with Maya. I'll also assign someone to cover the next two design reviews — I'll confirm who in a minute.

Maya Patel: Appreciate it. I'll upload the doctor's note to the portal later today.

Jordan Lee: Noted. Priya will follow up with a confirmation email and next steps once intake is complete. Keeping this thread for transparency; please avoid posting medical details here.

Priya Singh: Email sent with intake link and a short headphones reimbursement form. Quick Q @Sam — can you confirm who will cover the Tue design review on 3/12?

Sam Torres: Assigned to Elena for 3/12. :thumbsup:

Aisha Khan: We'll do a formal check in in 4 weeks to review how the accommodations are working and whether goals need adjustment. If performance concerns persist, we'll partner with manager to modify goals and supports. All private notes remain in HR systems; message me directly for anything sensitive.

Maya Patel: Thanks everyone — relief to have concrete steps. I'll DM @Jordan when the doc is uploaded.

accommodations-bot: Intake form received for Maya Patel at 2026-03-12T14:12Z (records stored in HR system).
